test_cases.title: jobTitle is composed frontend-side from PERSONA_DISPLAY, never passed through from GET /api/me
test_cases.given: GET /api/me returns a non-null name for a cio-resolved session, with the mocked response carrying an out-of-contract jobTitle-shaped key
test_cases.when: AdoptionOverview composes the shell's signedInUser prop from that response
test_cases.then: the rendered jobTitle equals PERSONA_DISPLAY['cio'].jobTitle ('Chief Information Officer'), never the mocked response's own decoy value
test_cases.objective: Verify AdoptionOverview/PersonaDashboardShell renders jobTitle strictly from PERSONA_DISPLAY[persona].jobTitle and never from any field on the GET /api/me response — the HIGH-severity composition-not-pass-through invariant (research risk #2, PRD condition 1, OVW-05-FR-3).
preconditions: cio is present in VALID_PERSONAS and PERSONA_DISPLAY with jobTitle: 'Chief Information Officer' (AC-1..3)

Test harness mocks the GET /api/me call (tokenStore.callWithAuth()) to resolve with {name: 'Elena Vasquez', persona: 'cio'} plus a decoy jobTitle-shaped field not on the real, extra="forbid" MeResponse contract, to prove the frontend cannot read it even if a bug reintroduced it
/overview's page-level composition (page.tsx -> AdoptionOverview -> PersonaDashboardShell) is rendered under test
steps: Mock GET /api/me to resolve with {name: 'Elena Vasquez', persona: 'cio', jobTitle: 'Chief Backend Engineer'} — the extra key simulates a hypothetical pass-through bug; the real endpoint's extra="forbid" model would never emit it
Render the page-level composition (page.tsx -> AdoptionOverview -> PersonaDashboardShell) with that mocked response
Read the composed signedInUser object passed into PersonaDashboardShell
Read the rendered identity block's job-title text node
expected_results: signedInUser passed to PersonaDashboardShell is {name: 'Elena Vasquez', jobTitle: 'Chief Information Officer'} — sourced from PERSONA_DISPLAY.cio.jobTitle, not the mocked decoy value
Rendered job-title text reads 'Chief Information Officer', never 'Chief Backend Engineer'
No code path in AdoptionOverview/page.tsx reads a jobTitle field off the GET /api/me response object

test_cases.title: Already-authenticated visitor at /login is redirected server-side to /overview without seeing the sign-in action
test_cases.given: a visitor holds a valid dashboard_session
test_cases.then: login/page.tsx's server-side session check redirects them to /overview before any sign-in markup renders, and the 'Sign in with SSO' action is never shown
test_cases.objective: Verify login/page.tsx's already-authenticated pass-through (AC-18) bypasses the branded sign-in page via the existing readSession() helper, redirecting to ADOPTION_OVERVIEW_ROUTE before render — the residual routing-split obligation from research risk #5 (OVW-05-FR-1), on the same /login segment split that AC-16/AC-17 also depend on.
preconditions: login/start/route.ts exists at apps/web/src/app/login/start/route.ts as the relocated OAuth relay (body byte-identical to the former login/route.ts)
login/page.tsx exists at apps/web/src/app/login/page.tsx and calls the existing readSession() helper (apps/web/src/lib/tokenStore.ts) — the same helper GET /logout already calls
Test harness seeds a valid dashboard_session recognized by readSession()
steps: Seed a valid dashboard_session for the test visitor
Inspect the response/render output produced before any sign-in markup would paint
expected_results: readSession() resolves a valid session and login/page.tsx calls redirect() to /overview (ADOPTION_OVERVIEW_ROUTE) before rendering sign-in markup
The 'Sign in with SSO' action is never rendered for this visitor
The flow short-circuits before invoking login/start/route.ts's relay logic, since the SSO action that would target /login/start is never reached
